original: 考えてみたらさ、三人でこうやって\n仕事をするのって初めてだよね
traducao: Come to think of it, this is the first\ntime the three of us have worked together.

original: そういえばそうですね
traducao: Now that you mention it, that is true.

original: 同行者の選定は、アンジュさんが\n適性を見て毎回判断されていますから
traducao: Ange always evaluates our aptitudes\nwhen selecting companions for a job.

original: 適性、か……。\nなるほどね
traducao: Aptitude, huh...?\nI see.

original: オレが賑やかし担当、\nミントが癒し系担当、\nヴェイグがむっつり系担当って事だね！
traducao: So I'm in charge of excitement,\nMint provides the soothing vibes, and\nVeigue is on gloomy silence duty!

original: シングさん、それはちょっと……
traducao: Shing, that's a bit much...

original: 「むっつり」ではなく\nせめて「だんまり」と……
traducao: Instead of "gloomy",\nperhaps "quiet" would be better...

original: ……それはフォローのつもりなのか？
traducao: ...Is that supposed to make it better?

original: コングマンさんの声は、\n大きくて、よく通る声ですね
traducao: Your voice really is loud and carries\nso well, Kongman.

original: おうよ！\n俺様はチャンピオンだ、\n常に堂々としてなけりゃならねえ
traducao: Hell yeah!\nThe Champ has always gotta carry himself\nwith pride and majesty!

original: 腹から声を出すのは、基本だぜ！
traducao: Projecting from your gut is the basics!

original: でも、……その、\n近くでお話する時は\nもう少し小さな声で話しても……
traducao: Still... um, when speaking close by,\nperhaps you could lower your voice\njust a little bit...?

original: 何でぇ？\n俺様の声がうるせえって言いたいのか？
traducao: What's that?\nYou saying the Champ's voice is noisy!?

original: そんな事は……。\nただ、せっかく素敵な声なのに\n少し怖い人に感じてしまいます
traducao: Not at all...\nIt's just that despite such a fine voice,\npeople might find you a bit scary.

original: 怖い？　\n俺様がか？
traducao: Scary?\nThe Champ, scary!?

original: はい。\n大きな音は、人を萎縮させます。\n本能的な反応なのかもしれませんが
traducao: Yes.\nLoud noises make people recoil.\nPerhaps it's an instinctive reaction.

original: んじゃ、フィリアさんも\n俺様の事を怖がってるかも\nしれねえって事か
traducao: Does that mean Philia might\nbe scared of the Champ too!?\nCould that really be it...?

original: それは……聞いてみないと\n何とも言えませんが……。\nもしかしたら、そうかもしれません
traducao: Well, I couldn't say for sure\nwithout asking her...\nbut that might just be possible.

original: なるほどなぁ……勉強になったぜ
traducao: I see... That's quite a lesson.

original: 女心ってのは複雑なんだな！！
traducao: A woman's heart really is complicated!!

original: ええと……。\n女心とは、\nあまり関係ないと思います……
traducao: Um...\nI don't think this has anything\nto do with a woman's heart...

original: おう、ミント！\nちょっと聞きてぇ事があるんだけどよ
traducao: Hey, Mint!\nGot something I wanna ask you.

original: 私にわかる事でしたら……。\n何でしょうか？
traducao: If it's something I can help with...\nWhat is it?

original: 実は、フィリアさんに\nプ、プレゼントを渡そうと\n思うんだけどよ……
traducao: Well, see, I'm thinking of giving\na pr-present to Philia...\nbut I don't know what to get.

original: そうなんですか。\nそれは素敵ですね
traducao: Is that so?\nThat sounds wonderful.

original: だろ？　\nそこで、だ
traducao: Right?\nSo here's the thing!

original: 女性ってのは、どんな物を渡されたら\n嬉しいと思うもんなんだ？
traducao: What kind of gift makes a woman\nhappy when she gets it?

original: そうですね……
traducao: Let me see...

original: 好みもあるとは思いますが\nどんな人でも、心のこもった贈り物なら\n嬉しく思うのではないでしょうか
traducao: Preferences certainly vary, but\nanyone would be happy to receive a gift\nthat comes straight from the heart.

original: 心がこもったもの、か……。\nなるほどな、よし！
traducao: From the heart, huh...?\nAll right, got it!

original: じゃあ、俺様の愛のメッセージ入り\n等身大フィギュアなんてのはどうだ！？
traducao: How about a life-sized figure of me\nwith a personalized love message!?

original: いつでも俺様を身近に感じられる\n自信作だぜ。\nしかも純金製のレア物だ！
traducao: A masterpiece that lets her feel\nthe Champ close anytime!\nPlus, it's rare solid gold!

original: どうだ、いい考えだろ！？
traducao: Well? Isn't that an awesome idea!?

original: それは……\nあまりおすすめ出来ません
traducao: I... really would not\nrecommend doing that.

original: よう……ミント……
traducao: Hey... Mint...

original: コングマンさん？
traducao: Kongman?

original: どうされたんですか。\n随分元気がない様ですが……
traducao: What's the matter?\nYou seem terribly downcast...

original: さっきフィリアさんの所に行ったら\nスタンの奴と楽しそうに\n話しててよぉ……
traducao: I just went to see Philia,\nand she was happily chatting\naway with Stahn...

original: そうだったんですか……。\nそれで、落ち込んでいたんですね
traducao: Is that what happened...?\nNo wonder you're feeling down.

original: 落ち込む？　\nどうしてだ？
traducao: Feeling down?\nWhy would I be down?

original: え？\nスタンさんにやきもちを\n焼いていたのでは……
traducao: Huh?\nWeren't you feeling jealous\ntoward Stahn...?

original: まさか！\n俺様はフィリアさんの\n慈悲深い心に、いたく感動したんだ！
traducao: No way!\nI was deeply moved by Philia's\nincredibly merciful heart!

original: どんな寝ぼすけが相手だろうと\n分け隔て無く、優しく接する……。\nまさしく女神の様じゃねえか
traducao: Even to a total sleepyhead,\nshe shows such warmth and kindness...!\nShe's an absolute goddess!

original: そ……そうですね
traducao: I... I suppose so.

original: ああ、フィリアさんッ！\nあの笑顔を思い出しただけで\n俺様の心臓は破裂しそうだぁあぁ！！
traducao: Oh, Philia!\nJust remembering that smile of hers\nmakes my heart feel like it'll burst!!

original: いけません、\nどうか落ち着いて\n呼吸を整えて下さい！
traducao: Oh dear!\nPlease calm down\nand catch your breath!

original: うおおおおおおお！！！！
traducao: Woooooaaaaagh!!!!

original: 聞いてくれミント！\n今日はついにフィリアさんに\n１０回話しかける事に成功したぞ！
traducao: Listen to this, Mint!\nToday I finally managed to talk\nto Philia ten whole times!

original: 頑張っているんですね、コングマンさん
traducao: You're really working hard, Kongman.

original: おう！\nフィリアさんと話してると\n元気が無限にわいてくるぜぇ！
traducao: Yeah!\nWhenever I talk to Philia,\nlimitless energy wells up inside me!

original: その気持ち……わかります
traducao: I... understand that feeling.

original: 心強い様な、あたたかい様な……、\n不思議な気持ちですよね
traducao: It feels reassuring and warm...\nIt's truly a wondrous feeling.

original: 何でぇ？\nミントにも、気になる相手がいるのか？
traducao: What's that?\nDo you have someone on your mind, Mint?

original: えっ……？\nそ、そんな事……教えられませんっ
traducao: Huh...?\nI-I couldn't possibly tell you that!

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n
